items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: Well, the one that I especially knew of that's good is Bigard... And Andrew Jefferson, even though they're good drummers.

ctx.x: Well, the one that I especially knew of that's good is Bigard, from the Whirling R.D.M.s along. And Andrew Jefferson, even though they're good drummers.
And he doesn't get too much work around the quarter. Who is that? Jefferson. I've never seen him in a quarter much. Oh, no? I can't understand him. No.
